extDescription.message: Dual subtitles (EN + RU) in any HTML5 player, word translation on hover and word learning.

busy_find_player.message: Looking for the player on the page…

history_empty_on.message: Videos you watched with Double Sub will appear here, so you can continue where you stopped.

history_empty_off.message: Saving history is off. You can turn it on in settings.

words_empty_text.message: Click a word in the subtitles to save it. Then review it here.

review_done_text.message: Words reviewed: $1. The next ones will return when their time comes.

voice_random.message: Mixed: a new voice for every word

voices_more_mac.message: More voices: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices.

type_sdh.message: for the deaf (sound descriptions will be removed)

access_pick_here.message: Choose among the videos on this page

nothing_title.message: No video found on the page.

nothing_text.message: If the player is still loading, click “Search again”.

reload_search.message: Reload the page and search from the start

remember_text.message: Next time the player will be found by itself and the subtitles will appear at once, without a click on the icon.

remember_denied.message: Access was not granted, the site was not remembered.

auto_hint.message: Next time the player will be found without a click on the icon
